title: 完蛋！我被男同学包围了
description:
"Damn! I'm Surrounded by Male Classmates" is a story-driven daily school life game created by a God-Damn high school student!

The game offers rich story content and choices. Players can unlock specific storylines for each male classmate through different decisions and unlock various endings at the conclusion of the game!

Main male classmates in the game:

Tang Wang: The most energetic student in class, an expert at pranks and being a jokester.

Bai Zi: The easiest-going classmate sitting in front of you—timid yet adorable.

Gou Ge: A star athlete who gives off a vibe of raw toughness.

Tank: A helpful and warm-hearted boy; if you're in trouble, he will definitely have your back until the very end!

Sao Huo: The terrifying demon of the class who frequently bullies other students.

After reading for so long, are you still not interested????

Hurry up and experience our God-Damn game right now!!!!
description_short: A high school daily life Visual Novel—Players will take on the role of a "nobody" in high school, experiencing a hilarious campus story of suddenly being surrounded by male classmates and enjoying a time full of youth and fun.
